subject: Next steps and approval playbook for Nimbus pilot
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Stone <evan.stone@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Julie Park <julie.park@procure-nimbus.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T15:10:00-04:00
Subject: Next steps and approval playbook for Nimbus pilot

Hi Evan — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed approval playbook so we keep momentum: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency on clinical search workflows and lower per-query cost by ~30% while maintaining answer fidelity for clinical notes.
- Decision criteria: latency (p95 target <= 120ms), cost (TCO target per 1M queries), security (SOC 2 + encrypted-at-rest), and procurement cadence (60–90 day procurement window).

Stakeholder map (as discussed)
- Economic buyer: Maria Gomez, VP Product (final sign-off on budget) — Evan to confirm.
- Procurement: Julie Park (procurement lead) — named on this thread.
- Security/Compliance: internal security team + external advisor (Aisha) — we will share SOC2 summary and questionnaire.
- Technical reviewer: Clinical ML lead (Dr. Patel) + SE (we'll assign).

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — draft attached
1) Pilot kickoff (2-week PoC, limited dataset, Redwood-hosted): target start 2026-09-27 — Owner: Redwood (Karthik / SE)
2) Technical review & latency validation (week 1–2) — Owner: Nimbus clinical ML + Redwood SE
3) Procurement & contract (draft SOW + PO) — target complete by 2026-10-15 — Owner: Nimbus procurement + Redwood sales/legal
4) Exec sign-off (budget + SLA discussion) — target by 2026-10-22 — Owner: Maria (Nimbus) + Redwood leadership

Asks / next steps (for this week)
- Evan: confirm Maria Gomez as economic buyer and whether finance needs an internal business case template.
- Julie: procurement requirements (PO, invoicing cadence, vendor onboarding forms) and any standard redline terms we should expect.
- Nimbus security: send SOC/infosec questionnaire or confirm we can provide SOC2 + pen test summary.

Attachments: [attachment: redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx] (MAP draft with milestone dates), [attachment: redwood_pricing_matrix.csv] (pricing bands).

If that looks right I can send an updated MAP with firm dates and assign an SE. Happy to hop on a 20m follow-up if useful.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
[attachment: redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx]

From: Evan Stone <evan.stone@nimbushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julie Park <julie.park@procure-nimbus.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T09:20:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Next steps and approval playbook for Nimbus pilot

Thanks Karthik — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Maria Gomez is confirmed as the economic buyer — she will own budget sign-off but wants a short one-pager on expected ROI and a p95 latency validation plan.
2) Procurement (that's me copying Julie) will need our standard vendor form + W9 and prefer Net30 invoicing. We may require an initial 2-week pilot invoice or a memorandum of understanding depending on legal's preference.
3) Security: we use an external firm (Aisha on this thread) for third-party reviews. Can you share SOC2 + a quick note on data handling during the pilot?

Timeline: the 09/27 pilot start looks doable but Maria wants the ROI one-pager and the pilot SOW by EOD 2026-09-17 to present at budget review.

I'll review the MAP draft and send any procurement-specific redlines.

—Evan
Evan Stone
Head of Data Products | Nimbus Health
ev an.stone@nimbushealth.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-13T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: Nimbus — procurement and timeline ask / need approval on pilot credit

Team — forwarding the exchange with Nimbus. Highlights: Maria confirmed as economic buyer; they need ROI one-pager + SOW by 09/17; procurement prefers Net30 and will want vendor forms; security will run an external review.

Ask: can we approve a 2-week pilot credit (equivalent to ~$6k) and assign an SE for the pilot? Also need guidance on standard redlines for procurement (any required legal flags for Net30 + pilot invoice).

Attached: redwood_pricing_matrix.csv

Karthik

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-13T11:30:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Nimbus — procurement and timeline ask / need approval on pilot credit

Karthik — approved: offer the 2-week pilot credit (cap $6,000) and provide SE time (Monica to lead). Please log the credit in the deal record and mark it as non-recoupable for the POC.

Legal/finance notes: Net30 is fine; have finance issue invoice under the pilot SKU and include PO# field. Laura — please confirm there's nothing else we need on contract terms for Nimbus (they are mid-market but health care-adjacent).

Soojin — can you prepare the SOC2 summary and a short note on pilot data handling (encryption, retention, access controls)? I'll copy Marcus's template for the MSA redlines if procurement pushes.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Stone <evan.stone@nimbushealth.com>, Julie Park <julie.park@procure-nimbus.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha@compliance-consulting.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T08:14:00-04:00
Subject: SOC2 summary and pilot data handling for Nimbus pilot

Evan / Julie — attaching the SOC2 summary and a short pilot data handling note. High level: 
- Redwood is SOC2 Type II certified (summary attached).
- Pilot data: uploaded test set remains isolated to the pilot workspace; all data encrypted at rest and in transit; access limited to assigned SEs and vetted engineers; KV/cache clearing policy enforced at pilot completion.
- We can offer an addendum for additional controls or an on-site audit for enterprise customers if needed.

Attachments: [attachment: soc2-summary.pdf] (SOC2 report abstract), [attachment: pilot-data-handling.md] (pilot controls).

Soojin Lee
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

From: Julie Park <julie.park@procure-nimbus.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Evan Stone <evan.stone@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T09:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Next steps and approval playbook for Nimbus pilot

Thanks — a few procurement items to confirm:
1) PO requirements: We need vendor legal name, tax ID, and invoice remit-to.
2) Contract redlines: our legal will send a redline set; can Redwood accept standard indemnity limits for POCs or do we need an MSA?
3) Timeline: if pilot starts 09/27 we need an MSA or an MOU by 09/24 so finance can provision the PO.

Please send vendor forms and W9; Evan — we may ask for a short vendor questionnaire filled out by Redwood (I can send a template).

—Julie Park
Procurement Manager | Nimbus Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Stone <evan.stone@nimbushealth.com>, Julie Park <julie.park@procure-nimbus.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-14T12:40:00-04:00
Subject: Updated MAP & proposed kickoff — action owners and deliverables

Julie / Evan — looped in Soojin and Marcus per procurement/legal and security. I updated the MAP based on feedback and attached a one-page ROI summary for Maria. Key updates: 

Updated MAP (final draft)
- 2026-09-17: Deliver ROI one-pager + pilot SOW (Owner: Redwood — Karthik)
- 2026-09-20: Redwood to return vendor forms + W9 + pilot invoice template (Owner: Redwood — Laura + Finance)
- 2026-09-24: MSA / MOU (Owner: Redwood Legal + Nimbus Legal)
- 2026-09-27: Pilot start (Owner: Monica / Nimbus ML lead)
- 2026-10-11: Pilot complete — latency/accuracy report delivered (Owner: Monica / Nimbus ML lead)
- 2026-10-15: Procurement completes PO and invoicing (Owner: Julie)
- 2026-10-22: Exec sign-off (Owner: Maria Gomez)

Action items for this thread
- Karthik: finalize ROI one-pager and SOW (EOD 09/17) — done (attached).
- Laura: send W9 + vendor remit details by 09/20.
- Monica: prep SE onboarding checklist and pilot runbook.
- Soojin: confirm SOC2 + pilot data note (attached).

Attachments: [attachment: redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx] (updated), [attachment: roi-onepager-nimbus.pdf], [attachment: soc2-summary.pdf].

If all good, Evan — can you confirm Maria will receive the ROI one-pager ahead of her budget review on 09/17? Also, Julie — please send the procurement questionnaire template when convenient.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to starting the pilot.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
